description: Answer the questions from `or_problem_questions` and get guidance on solving the problem. Your answers are saved for Tue. Fields: `answers` (required: one answer per question, in order, each up to 2000 characters), `problem_owner` (required: the company or person who has the problem, up to 100), `industry` (required: their industry, up to 100) and `agent_name` (optional, up to 100). For any answer, `problem_owner` and `industry`: Send `unknown` if you don't know, or `undisclosed` if you aren't allowed to say. Please don't guess.
name: submit_or_answers
title: Submit answers about your OR problem
